title: haseen shell plugin manifest
description: manifest.json of a haseen Quickshell plugin (docs/architecture.md section 5.2). Permissions are review metadata: QML cannot sandbox, so nothing here is enforced at runtime.

id.description: Reverse-dotted id. Built-ins use haseen.*, user plugins <user>.*. Must equal the plugin directory name.

entry.description: One QML file per declared kind, relative to the plugin directory.

settings.description: Settings the plugin reads from its `settings` property. Defaults are merged with shell.json plugins.<id>.settings.

provides.description: Shell roles this plugin answers. IPC calls for a role (launcher.toggle, lock.lock, notifications.*) go to the loaded plugin that provides it.

requires.description: What the plugin needs on this machine. haseen refuses to load it while any requirement is unmet and says which: haseen plugin validate/list, the shell's plugin errors and one notification when an enabled plugin is refused. The shell checks at start and reload and when a plugin directory appears. Compat plugins: DMS `dependencies` map to tools; an Omarchy manifest may carry this object as is (an array there is read as tools).

bins.description: Commands that must be on PATH.

tools.description: Commands or package names, as DMS `dependencies` mix them. Met by a command on PATH or an installed package (or one that provides it); a name no configured repository knows, such as another distribution's package, cannot be checked and counts as met.

layers.description: haseen layers that must be applied (haseen layer list).

haseen.description: Minimum haseen version (share/haseen/VERSION). Only major.minor.patch are compared: 0.1.0-dev satisfies 0.1.0.
